name: Mandrasuchus
sum: Mandrasuchus is a semi-aquatic alligatorine from the Danian Denver Formation of Colorado, found in the first million years after the K-Pg event.
wsnote: Up to about 2 m long (English Wikipedia).
holotype: DMNH EPV.48541, including a skull, tail, osteoderms and several limb fossils.
biology: Possibly a macro-generalist predator that used rounded back teeth to crush shelled prey (English Wikipedia).
author: Lessner et al. 2026

sources.text: Lessner, E. J., Sherman, S. M., Petermann, H., Panigot, E., Duffy, F. and Lyson, T. R. 2026. New alligatorid, Mandrasuchus milleri, from the Early Paleocene (Danian) of the Denver Basin supports earliest Paleocene North American alligatorid radiation. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology e2712566.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Early Paleocene (Danian) per English Wikipedia.
